structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E056. Tip E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 (seeds 0-2). Same-code rerun E050: 5.206 s, 0.7552. Rebuilds of one commit move the 3-seed mean by about 0.3 pp and time by about ±0.03-0.05 s. E056 (ReLU diagnostic) came in at 4.95 s, 0.752, so my 5.12 s forecast missed; recent time misses were all on the fast side.

Mechanisms and support:
1. Epoch dial: about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch for 0.0-0.25 pp, roughly 1.5-2 s/pp (E020, E023, E027, E049).
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded, E006) are in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters were flat or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd, LS). Optimizer, averaging and regularization are flat within about 0.2 pp.
3. Time tracks pixels. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Trimming steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E045, E048, E052).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049, E053). It is bandwidth-heavy. A stem freeze before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a larger dose (E053 +0.26 pp on 3 seeds, -0.12 s).
5. Architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051).
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047), so systems work recovers at most about 1%. E056's measured times fell below forecast, so the activation swap may save more than I assumed.
7. Noise: population mean about 0.752. Headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted time for freezes, selection and ReLU (E046, E048, E052, E056). I under-predicted E053's accuracy.

Unsure:
- The size of the rebuild SD. I guess 0.1 pp on a 20-seed mean.
- Whether E052 and E053 pass a frozen gate.
- Whether coarse labels are available.
- Whether the ReLU time saving is real, or just build noise.

forecasts.reason: Fresh seeds will read about 0.1 pp below the 0.7539 on reused seeds. Rebuild SD is probably 0.05-0.12 pp.
E052 and E053 populations are about 0.751-0.752. With sigma_tot near 0.12 pp, the 1.64-sigma gate is likely to fail for them.
Removing 0.25 epoch should save about 0.1 s and cost about 0.05-0.1 pp. That prices the dial near 1-2 s/pp, but the noise is large.
Coarse labels are probably available in the train pickle, but the rules may bar the extra signal. If it runs, the effect is uncertain and likely small.
The port already freezes BN weight (requires_grad=False in the BatchNorm class), so this probably closes by reading the code with no run.
Detaching the whitening bias earlier saves little and is probably accuracy-neutral within noise.
Offline diagnostic. The curves will likely be only loosely consistent with the known outcomes.

cruxes: Is the rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean at least 0.08 pp? If so, the sub-0.15 pp keep decisions since E044 are noise.
Does ReLU or any cheaper activation really save at least 3% of time? E056's 4.95 s hints at it, but build noise is about 1%.
Do the coarse labels ship in the training set, and do the rules allow them? That would unlock the only untested time-neutral accuracy lever.
